text_block_list.text:
I've come to a shrine with Ines Fujin,<n>who's been
in something of a funk<n>lately.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You know, I've actually worked here<n>as a shrine
maiden before. Well, it<n>was more volunteering than
working.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I had some initial training where I was<n>taught the
traditional way to bow and<n>walk. And they shared
some Shinto<n>teachings with me too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm going to use what I<n>learned back then to
reach out to the<n>gods and have them hear my
troubles.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
O divine spirits, I thank you for your<n>continued
protection and guidance,<n>and ask that you continue
to watch<n>over me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, that's my praying done. All<n>that's left is to
put in the work on my<n>side.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Do you have a moment? I have a<n>question about
the god of this shrine.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, but today's my first day<n>here. I'm not
very knowledgeable on<n>the subject yet...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I know about that stuff, so I can<n>answer your
question!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Visitor
text_block_list.text:
How illuminating! Thank you very<n>much for your
thorough explanation.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And thank you, too—for being such a<n>patient
listener!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I got to help out at the shrine<n>again. Good
thing I paid attention<n>when I was on maiden duty
before. ♪

Her prayers answered, Ines Fujin<n>regains her
energy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I remember hearing about the god<n>of this shrine
when I was a shrine<n>maiden! You see, well, um...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Uh... W-wait, huh? I keep drawing<n>blanks... Urk, the
gods won't like this!

Disappointed in herself, Ines Fujin<n>struggles to
shake off her doldrums.
